products.subtitle: Polished hematite · elastic fit
products.descriptionHtml:
Reclaim Your Edge Confidence Natural Hematite Stone Beaded Stretch Healing Bracelets Gift Jewelry

Polished hematite beads on a stretch elastic core, no clasp, no hardware, nothing to break. Metallic gunmetal-black, dense enough to notice the moment you pick it up.

Hematite is an iron oxide, one of the most abundant iron ores on Earth, cut and polished here for jewellery rather than industrial use. That iron content is what gives every bead its weight: pick the bracelet up and it sits heavier in the hand than its size suggests, and under the black polish it streaks red-brown when scratched, the same test a mineralogist would use to confirm the real stone rather than dyed glass or resin.

At 5.5-6.5 on the Mohs scale, it's roughly as hard as hardened steel, hard enough to take daily knocks against a desk, a doorframe or a dumbbell without dulling, and hard enough that the hand-polished gunmetal finish stays a finish, not a coating that wears through. There's no plating to chip and no coating over the stone: what you see the day it arrives is what you'll still see years in.

The build is as low-maintenance as the material: a single stretch elastic core threaded through the beads, no clasp and no sizing chart. Roll it over your hand and forget it's there, it fits a range of wrist sizes without ever needing adjustment, and there's no clasp mechanism to eventually fail.

  • Genuine stone, not imitation: real hematite (iron oxide), verifiable by its red-brown streak, not resin or dyed glass standing in for it.
  • Built to take daily wear: 5.5-6.5 Mohs hardness holds up to knocks, desks and gym bags without dulling the polish.
  • No clasp to break: one stretch elastic core, on in one motion, nothing to fasten or eventually snap.
  • Fits without sizing: the elastic core stretches across a wide range of wrist sizes, so there's no chart to check before you order.
  • Substantial by design: 70g of dense, iron-rich stone on a single strand, present enough to feel deliberate under a cuff.
  • Finish that lasts: hand-polished directly on the stone, with no plating or coating to wear through over time.
  • Pairs with anything black or steel-toned: the gunmetal shine reads as understated metal, so it layers cleanly with a watch or a second bracelet without competing for attention.

We describe hematite for what it verifiably is composition, hardness, the streak test, not what it will do for you beyond that. No health claims, just a genuine stone built into a bracelet that's easy to wear every day and hard to wear out.

products.subtitle: Magnetic or non-magnetic · sizes 6–10
products.descriptionHtml: A curved hematite band in two finishes: natural non-magnetic hematite, or a man-made magnetic hematite (often called "hematine") for the magnetic variants. Natural hematite itself is only weakly magnetic — the strongly magnetic feel in the "Magnetic" sizes comes from that man-made version, same as most magnetic hematite jewellery on the market. We would rather tell you that than let you assume otherwise.

specs.label: Stone
specs.description: Hematite in two finishes - natural or a magnetic composite, sold and labelled as what each actually is.
